description: Every .claude/hooks/lib file each shared safety behaviour loads, relative to .claude/hooks/lib. `lib` is the require closure of the behaviour's Claude Code shell; `spawned` are lib scripts it runs as child processes. `bundled` is what a non-Claude runtime's hook tree carries (the two safety behaviours, the runtime adapter, and the dependency-free completion-check core the Codex and Cursor stop hooks require): the runtime shells there require exactly these files, copied byte for byte by the sync script in the kit's source repository and checked by its tests. `helpers` are the workflow-* scripts skill preambles run, the stdin reader the skill guard scripts require, and the files those require; each bundle carries a byte-for-byte copy of them in every `helperBinDirs` entry, where its skills call them.
